WITH AlamedaCounty AS (
  SELECT 
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School,
    s.Charter,
    s.LowGrade,
    s.HighGrade,
    f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] AS FreeMealRate,
    f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] - (SELECT AVG([Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)]) FROM frpm WHERE `County Name` = 'Alameda') AS FreeMealRateDeviation,
    CASE 
      WHEN COALESCE(fs.AvgScrRead, 0) + COALESCE(fs.AvgScrMath, 0) + COALESCE(fs.AvgScrWrite, 0) < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
      WHEN COALESCE(fs.AvgScrRead, 0) + COALESCE(fs.AvgScrMath, 0) + COALESCE(fs.AvgScrWrite, 0) BETWEEN 1200 AND 1500 THEN 'Average'
      WHEN COALESCE(fs.AvgScrRead, 0) + COALESCE(fs.AvgScrMath, 0) + COALESCE(fs.AvgScrWrite, 0) > 1500 THEN 'Above Average'
      ELSE 'No SAT Data'
    END AS SATPerformanceLevel
  FROM 
    schools s
  JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  JOIN 
    satscores fs ON s.CDSCode = fs.cds
  WHERE 
    s.County = 'Alameda'
),
HighestFreeMealRate AS (
  SELECT 
    CDSCode,
    MAX(FreeMealRate) AS MaxFreeMealRate
  FROM 
    AlamedaCounty
  GROUP BY 
    CDSCode
)
SELECT 
  ac.CDSCode,
  ac.School,
  ac.Charter,
  ac.LowGrade,
  ac.HighGrade,
  ac.FreeMealRate,
  ac.FreeMealRateDeviation,
  ac.SATPerformanceLevel
FROM 
  AlamedaCounty ac
JOIN 
  HighestFreeMealRate hrm ON ac.CDSCode = hrm.CDSCode AND ac.FreeMealRate = hrm.MaxFreeMealRate;	----- bird -----	california_schools

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.Zip,
    s.State,
    s.OpenDate,
    s.StatusType,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)`,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` AS FreeMealRate,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS FRPMRate,
    sats.AvgScrRead,
    sats.AvgScrMath,
    sats.AvgScrWrite,
    sats.NumGE1500,
    CASE 
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 75 THEN 'High FRPM'
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` BETWEEN 50 AND 75 THEN 'Medium FRPM'
        ELSE 'Low FRPM'
    END AS FRPMCategory
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN 
    satscores sats ON s.CDSCode = sats.cds
WHERE 
    s.County = 'Fresno County Office of Education'
    AND s.Charter = 1
    AND f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` DESC;	----- bird -----	california_schools

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.StreetAbr,
    s.City,
    s.Zip,
    s.State,
    s.MailStreet,
    s.MailStrAbr,
    s.MailCity,
    s.MailZip,
    s.MailState,
    s.Website,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)`,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` AS FRPM_Percentage,
    f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS FRPM_Count,
    sats.AvgScrRead,
    sats.AvgScrMath,
    sats.AvgScrWrite,
    sats.NumGE1500,
    CASE 
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` > 70 AND sats.NumGE1500 >= 20 THEN 'Highly Unexpectedly Well'
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` < 30 AND sats.NumGE1500 < 10 THEN 'Highly Unexpectedly Poorly'
        ELSE 'Expected Performance'
    END AS Performance
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
JOIN 
    satscores sats ON f.CDSCode = sats.cds
WHERE 
    f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 0
    AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 100
ORDER BY 
    f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;	----- bird -----	california_schools

SELECT

    s.County,
    s.School,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)`,
    f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`,

        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS FRPMLevel

    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode

    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` + f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

WITH bond_counts AS (
  SELECT bond_type, COUNT(bond_id) AS total_occurrences
  FROM bond
  GROUP BY bond_type
),
most_common_bond AS (
  SELECT bond_type
  FROM bond_counts
  ORDER BY total_occurrences DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
molecule_bond_counts AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(bond_id) AS bond_count
  FROM bond
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
unique_element_pairs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a1.element, a2.element
  FROM atom a1
  JOIN connected c ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
  JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = (SELECT bond_type FROM most_common_bond)
),
molecule_labels AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = (SELECT bond_type FROM most_common_bond)
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
)
SELECT 
  bc.bond_type,
  bc.total_occurrences,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mbc.molecule_id) AS molecules_containing,
  AVG(mbc.bond_count) AS avg_bonds_per_molecule,
  COUNT(DISTINCT u.ep1) AS unique_element_pairs,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ml.label) AS molecule_labels
FROM 
  bond_counts bc
JOIN 
  most_common_bond mcb ON bc.bond_type = mcb.bond_type
JOIN 
  molecule_bond_counts mbc ON bc.bond_type = mbc.bond_type
JOIN 
  unique_element_pairs u ON bc.bond_type = u.bond_type
JOIN 
  molecule_labels ml ON bc.bond_type = ml.bond_type
GROUP BY 
  bc.bond_type, bc.total_occurrences;	----- bird -----	toxicology

SELECT 
    (y2012.Consumption - y2013.Consumption) / y2012.Consumption AS ConsumptionDecreaseRate
FROM 
    yearmonth y2012
JOIN 
    yearmonth y2013 ON y2012.CustomerID = y2013.CustomerID
JOIN 
    transactions_1k t ON y2012.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
WHERE 
    t.Date = '2012-08-25' AND t.Amount = 634.8;	----- bird -----	debit_card_specializing

SELECT g.GasStationID, g.ChainID, g.Country, SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS TotalRevenue
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
GROUP BY g.GasStationID, g.ChainID, g.Country
ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC
LIMIT 1;	----- bird -----	debit_card_specializing

SELECT 
    c.CustomerID, 
    c.Segment, 
    c.Currency, 
    AVG(t.Price / t.Amount) AS AveragePricePerItem, 
    SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS TotalSpent
FROM 
    customers c
JOIN 
    transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
GROUP BY 
    c.CustomerID, 
    c.Segment, 
    c.Currency
ORDER BY 
    TotalSpent DESC
LIMIT 1;	----- bird -----	debit_card_specializing
